ABOUT US
Company history
HAV Shipping Group is a fully integrated, wholly Norwegian owned, specialist shipowner, ship manager, operator, and charterer. We own and operate our quality fleet of 17 standardised, top classed, insured and maintained, single box hold dry cargo vessels (DWCC 2 – 4,000 MTS).
Our principal focus is upon providing the North Sea, Baltic and Mediterranean dry bulk, and project cargo, markets with a top quality swift, efficient, reliable and environmentally conscious service.
Our in house full service chartering and ship management teams are fully integrated to ensure a best in class, efficient and dependable service delivery.
VESSELS
Our Fleetlist
HAV’s standardised fleet of well maintained modern shallow air and sea draft, single box hold bulkers are wholly owned by the Hav Group. The majority of our vessels have movable bulkheads and all vessels are maintained to the highest of standards.
REGULATION ADVANTAGES
Ship Management
Technical Management
HSMN’s teams handle all aspects of vessel management, including operations, inspections, repairs, conversions, project development, quality assurance, manning, purchasing, cost control and accounting.
Crewing
HAV Ship Management’s (HSM’s) dedicated Oslo based crewing team, provides a full crew management service to the HAV Group and its clients. With a portfolio of approximately 700 highly skilled seafarers, HSM ensures that each managed vessel is manned with qualified and well-trained officers and ratings.
Commercial Management
In addition to commercial management, HAV Chartering also delivers a comprehensive commercial vessel operation service, this service includes fleet management, routing, liaison with agents and bunkering

pages.title: About – Hav.no
pages.main_text_excerpt:
OUR HISTORY
About the Company
Founded in 1999, HAV Shipping AS is a fully integrated, wholly Norwegian owned, specialist shipowner. From our head office in Oslo, Norway we are proud to provide our swift, efficient, reliable and environmentally conscious service to the European short sea and project cargo markets.
- The HAV Shipping group is fully Norwegian owned with headquarters in Oslo
- HAV focuses on serving the North Sea, Baltic and Mediterranean dry bulk, and project cargo, markets.
- Quality fleet of 17 standardised single box hold, low air draft, movable bulkheads, dry cargo vessels (DWT 2,000 – 4,000 MT).
- HAV aspires to being the most reputable and recognized player in the European short sea and river markets.
The HAV Shipping group is fully Norwegian owned with headquarters in Oslo
Quality fleet of 17 standardised single box hold, low air draft, movable bulkheads, dry cargo vessels (DWT 2,000 – 4,000 MT).
HAV focuses on serving the North Sea, Baltic and Mediterranean dry bulk, and project cargo, markets.
HAV aspires to being the most reputable and recognized player in the European short sea and river markets.
HAV Shipping Group
The HAV Shipping Group is comprised of, our ship owning unit, a full service chartering team and our specialist ship management team. Together, these three in house business units ensure an efficient, fully integrated service which includes chartering, ship management/crewing and ship owning/project services.
HAV Shipping, HAV Bulk, HAV Ship Management and HAV Chartering are all headquartered in Norway’s capital Oslo, a major shipping cluster.
HAV Shipping AS is a Norwegian company that is solely owned by Norwegian interests. The board consists of Petter Kleppan (Chairman) and Arnstein Endresen.
Company’s Course
The company’s operations focus primarily on the sea-river segment with smaller bulk and feeder vessels of 2,000 to 10,000 DWT. These vessels require efficient and well-organized maintenance due to North Sea voyage conditions, frequent port calls and diversity of bulk/project cargoes. The company handles all aspects of ship management, including ship operation, vessel inspection, repairs and conversions, project development, quality assurance, manning, purchasing, cost control and accounting. When pertinent, the company also interacts closely with HAV Chartering to optimize ship operation and ensure HES, QA/QC and ISM/ISPS compliance. 
Operation of company’s vessels is based on quality routines and systems, which meet the most stringent requirements of the flag and coastal states, classification rules, regulations and the charterers themselves.

pages.title: Ship Management – Hav.no
pages.main_text_excerpt:
MANAGEMENT ADVANTAGES
Ship Management
The Hav Group has been operating its very own management team for more than 20 years, consisting of two operational Units, Hav Chartering and Hav Ship Management(HSM).
HSM’s wealth of inhouse expertise ensures the delivery of a dependable, efficient and cost conscious fully integrated vessel management service which includes, technical, crew and commercial vessel management.
As HSM’s business and reputation grew, an increasing number of vessel owners, public and private listed companies, have chosen to entrust us with the responsibility of managing their vessels for them.
- Technical Management
Technical Management
HSM’ team has extensive experience managing both Hav’s fleet of vessels and those of its commercial clients. These vessels operate in the challenging sea–river segment which is principally served by bulk and feeder vessels ranging between 2,000 and 10,000 dwt. HSMN’s technical management team understands and, together with its network of repair and dry dock facilities, delivers the enhanced levels of safety and efficient well organized maintenance which these vessels’ operations, in the North Sea with frequent port calls and breadth of bulk/project cargoes, dictate.
HSM’s teams handle all aspects of vessel management, including operations, inspections, repairs, conversions, project development, quality assurance, manning, purchasing, cost control and accounting.
HSM cooperates closely with the HAV Group’s chartering arm, HAV Chartering, to optimize ship operation and ensure HES, QA/QC, ISM/ISPS compliance. Operation of HSM vessels is based on quality routines and systems that meet the requirements of the most stringent flag and coastal states, classification rules, regulations and the charterers themselves.
Crewing
- Crewing
HSM based in Oslo, provides a full crew management service to the HAV Group and its clients. With a portfolio of approximately 500 highly skilled seafarers, HSM ensures that each managed vessel is manned with qualified and well-trained officers and ratings. All aspects of crew management are dealt with by HSM inhouse, including recruitment, selection, labour/union relations, long-term strategic planning, pool arrangements, training, crew education and the provision of safety-instruction courses, the management of P&I claims relating to officers and ratings, mustering, travel arrangements, provisioning, budgeting, accounting and payroll. HSM’s crewing operation is certified to ISO 9001-2000 standards and holds a DNV certification as a Crew Manning Office.
Commercial Management
- Commercial Management
HAV Chartering AS is an expert provider of chartering services for the dry bulk 2,000 to 10,000 DWT market with a strong reputation for high performance and efficiency.
Hav Chartering is the exclusive broker, chartering manager and vessel operator for all tonnage owned and operated by the HAV Group.
HAV Chartering utilizes HAV’s growing fleet of interchangeable sister vessels, an extensive network of agents and HAV’s dedicated in group technical management and crewing service to ensure cost efficient, reliable, safe and timely delivery of all cargo types.
With a specialist knowledge of the European, Mediterranean and Atlantic Basin markets together with quality vessels and crews we can likely carry any dry cargo.
Our fleet of standardized shortsea vessels are equipped with moveable bulkheads to divide the cargo hold into several divisions, providing the flexibility to carry a wide variety of cargo types and grades.
- Commercial Operation
Commercial Operation
In addition to commercial management, HAV Chartering also delivers a comprehensive commercial vessel operation service, this service includes fleet management, routing, liaison with agents and bunkering.
Our operations team interacts closely with HAV Ship Management in order to the optimize operation of the managed fleet of vessels.
These synergies enable HAV Ship Management to efficiently and proactive coordinate all functions, including crewing, maintenance and delivery planning.
